title: Mass lower bound for a current with a measure representation (printed (1) of Simon 3.13)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let Y ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k), let μ be a measure on ℝ^N and κ : ℝ^N → Λ_k(ℝ^N) a field of k-vectors (NVector (Eucl N) k) such that (μ, κ) represents Y (IsMeasureRepresentation Y μ κ): for every test form ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^N) the function x ↦ κ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and Y(ω) = ∫ κ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x). Then ∫ |κ(x)| dμ(x) ≤ M(Y) in [0, ∞], where |w| := (Σ_γ w(dx^γ)²)^{1/2} is the Euclidean norm of a k-vector w (w(dx^γ) = euclideanNVectorCoordinate w γ, dx^γ = wedgeCovectors k (proj ∘ γ), γ ranging over the strictly increasing multi-indices SimonMultiIndex k N) and M(Y) = Y.mass = Y.massOn univ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (κ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsMeasureRepresentation Y μ κ → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ Y.mass
